textChanges.name: General
textChanges.noteText: Villagers returning to work from the Town Center now accept shift-click queued commands.

textChanges.name: General
textChanges.noteText: Relics will no longer be destroyed if deposited into a building just as it is destroyed.

textChanges.name: General
textChanges.noteText: Fixed an issue where switching to attacking a unit just after throwing a torch will cause a torch to be thrown at the enemy unit.

textChanges.name: General
textChanges.noteText: Fixed an issue where Scouts attempting to drop a carcass can sometimes fail.

textChanges.name: Grand Bazaar
textChanges.noteText: Fixed a bug which caused the Trade Ships’ extra resources from Grand Bazaar to be calculated incorrectly.

textChanges.name: City Planning
textChanges.noteText: The City Planning health bonus is now applied to Lumber Camps and Mining Camps within influence.

textChanges.name: Dromon
textChanges.noteText: Byzantine and Macedonian Dromons are now correctly labelled as “Massive Ship” instead of “Springald Ship”.

textChanges.name: Royal Knight (mercenary)

textChanges.name: Elite Varangian Guard
textChanges.noteText: Fixed an issue causing the Byzantine Elite Varangian Guard to fail to switch to the axe when the Berserking ability is used.

textChanges.name: Imperial Official

unmatched.noteText: Town Center construction time increased from 150 → 165 seconds.
unmatched.reason: Capital Town Centers (building_town_center_capital_*) share the 150 s field but are pre-placed, not constructed; left unchanged. Mongol packed Town Center (building_town_center_moving_mon) uses 30 s unpack time.

unmatched.noteText: Discount on Khan and Torguuds reduced from 20% → 15%.
unmatched.reason: The discount is a tent-choice modifier; Torguud/Batu Khan catalog costs are base values, so no cost field changes.

unmatched.noteText: Khan and Torguud increased health reduced from +30 → +25.
unmatched.reason: The +30 is a tent-choice modifier applied at runtime; catalog hp fields are base values.

unmatched.noteText: Landsknecht cost reduced from 60 Food 100 Gold → 50 Food 100 Gold.
unmatched.reason: unit_landsknecht_mercenaries_hre (Landsknecht Mercenaries, 40 Food 120 Gold) and the Byzantine mercenary Landsknecht (Silver/Olive Oil cost) do not have the quoted 60 Food price; left unchanged.

unmatched.noteText: Cataphract batch production time increased from 20 → 25 seconds.
unmatched.reason: unit_cataphract_4_byz_mac_ha has trainTimeSeconds 40, not the 20 s batch time quoted; the batch timer is a landmark action, not the unit field. Left unchanged.

unmatched.noteText: Landmark movement speed increased from 0.75 → 0.9.
unmatched.reason: Mongol landmark records (building_wonder_*_moving_mon) carry no speedEngineUnits field in the catalog; packed-landmark movement is a runtime state, so there is no field to overlay.

unmatched.noteText: Building discount reduced from 40% → 30%.
unmatched.reason: Civilization-wide discount applied at runtime; catalog building costs are base values, so no per-record field changes.
